name: Via Lugdunum, Lyon to Le Puy-en-Velay
description_md:
Via Lugdunum is a waymarked hiking route in France spanning 78.3 km. It features 1637 m of ascent and 1364 m of descent.

The trail has a difficulty rating of hard, which is derived from the distance and ascent. Walking the route takes about 24 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The geometry matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo, and the path is part of the international waymarked hiking network. Walkers will find that the route passes the Historic Site of Lyons within 300 m, Lugdunum within 300 m, and the Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourvière within 300 m.
